**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Void elements cannot have children
```

## How to fix

Self-close the void element and drop its children: `<br />`, `<img />`, `<input />`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <br>x</br>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <br />;
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Self-close the void element (drop its children)
